assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
京张四闸实施放行机制：每个项目必须依次通过G0资格闸、G1试点闸、G2放行闸、G3退役闸。缺任一闸则项目保持halted。
assumptions.impact: 四闸为概念框架，待主管部门确认标准。

assumptions.statement: Official precise polygon not published. Repository provides provisional rough boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All geometry files provisional_constraint, not official redline.

assumptions.statement: No field survey conducted. All AI scenario performance marked unverified.
assumptions.impact: No operational claims without field evidence.

assumptions.statement: Building counts, heights, function ratios are conceptual estimates.
Public Issue #1029 notes Dazhongsi provisional key area may be misaligned.
assumptions.impact: Treated as relocatable design container only.

assumptions.statement: Investment estimates concept-level (50%). Six projects total 10.4-21.6B RMB.
Operations governance and phased implementation are conceptual frameworks.
assumptions.impact: C-level assumptions. Pilots should precede capital-intensive construction.

assumptions.statement: 道路红线和交通组织方案基于公开资料推断，未经交通影响评价。慢行断点数量和位置需现场踏勘确认。
assumptions.impact: 交通方案为概念建议，正式方案需交通影响评价和路口渠化设计。

assumptions.statement: 绿地系统基于概念设计，未经生态本底调查。清河和小月河的蓝线范围、防洪标准和生态敏感区需水务部门确认。
assumptions.impact: 绿地布局和雨洪设施需生态本底调查和蓝线确认后调整。

assumptions.statement: 京张铁路遗址的保护范围和建设控制地带未经文保部门确认。清华园车站旧址的保护等级待定。
assumptions.impact: 文保范围内的建设活动需文保审批，可能影响重点区域设计方案。

assumptions.statement: AI产业招商目标(企业数量/类型/规模)基于产业定位推断，未经市场需求调研和招商可行性分析。
assumptions.impact: 产业空间比例和招商目标需市场需求调研和产业规划确认。

assumptions.statement: 社区参与方案(社区共建委员会/申诉回退机制)未经居民协商。社区对AI设施和数据采集的接受度未调查。
assumptions.impact: 社区参与机制需公示和协商后调整，可能影响AI场景部署节奏。
